nom: Estée Lauder Revitalizing Supreme+ Sculpting Face Serum for Firming & Anti-Aging

avis.texte: This serum is a creamy lightweight consistency that provides hydration. Its purpose is to be a sculpting serum that firms & lifts, containing collagen and hexapeptides. It does have a very light fragrance and absorbs quickly into the skin without a sticky/tacky or greasy feeling; it doesn't cause pillage either. I use it in the morning and at night depending on how I structure my skincare routine, applying it to my face and neck. Then I follow up with a moisturizer. My skin feels refreshed and supply afterwards. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

It naturally moisturizes the skin with nourishing ingredients that absorb quickly—making it especially beneficial for dry skin. You can use it alongside sunscreen or under makeup without worrying about your foundation looking cakey. It is the perfect solution for skin that tends to get dry, cracked, red, or uncomfortably irritated, particularly during the winter.

For skin that is dry, irritated, red, or itchy due to extreme dryness, simply using this product once or twice a day will make a noticeable difference. It absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky residue, making it suitable for use alongside sunscreen or before applying makeup. It has a pleasant scent and provides excellent hydration.

I have been using this serum for almost a month mostly in morning after my skincare regimen and sometimes at nigh can tell that my skin is starting to firm especially after the weight loss. I was told that this product is needed at my a late 30s and it working great so far.

Ive been using this serum consistently for the last 2-3 weeks and it has made my skin feel so hydrated and a bit brighter. Because I probably need more time with it, I didn't see too much of a difference however I do notice how lightweight it is, not sticky and absorbs into the skin perfectly. I highly recommend this product however you will need to give it time to see a significant difference however as a daily routine it feels amazing. *I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes*

I regularly use K beauty serums, so I was definitely interested in comparing this one. It has a very chemical sort of scent and when I sweated (it's summer here) it ran and got in my eyes, stinging them, hence the 4 stars instead of 5. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Unable to Give an Informed Opinion
avis.texte: It's honestly difficult to give an informed review of this product. I received this as a sample and have been using it daily morning and evening until I ran out. Do I like the feel of it? Yes. Does it feel hydrating on my skin? Yes. Is the scent pleasant? Yes. But, honestly it takes weeks to truly know a products efficacy due to cellular turnover etc, and I ran out within a little over a week. Have I noticed any huge signs of improvement during that time? None. Is my skin transformed? No. I just don't feel it's doing much of anything for me compared to other far less expensive serums I have tried. I do love Estee Lauder products and usually find them quite effective but I would be lying if I said I have noticed a huge difference in the time I was able to use it. There is just no way for me to give an educated or informed opinion. It is far too expensive for me to purchase without knowing the answer to that. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: A Luxurious Anti-Aging Serum That My Acne-Prone Skin Loved
avis.texte: I'm 34 and have acne-prone skin. I've been seriously looking for effective anti-aging skincare products for about five years now. Because my skin can be difficult to work with, I'm always a little hesitant when trying a new anti-aging product, especially something intended to be used every day. I ended up really loving the Estée Lauder Revitalizing Supreme+ Sculpting Face Serum for Lifting & Firming. I used it nightly as directed, and it quickly became one of the products I genuinely looked forward to using in my routine. The texture felt luxurious without being overly heavy, which was especially important for my acne-prone skin. What impressed me most was how my skin looked and felt with consistent use. My skin appeared smoother, more hydrated, and more refreshed. It gave my overall complexion a healthy, youthful-looking appearance. I also really liked that it felt like a true anti-aging treatment while still being comfortable enough for my skin type. After trying anti-aging products for the past several years, I've become pretty selective about what I continue using. This serum stood out to me because I actually enjoyed using it consistently, and I felt like my skin benefited from it rather than feeling irritated or weighed down. Overall, I would definitely recommend this serum to someone in their 30s who is starting to focus more seriously on prevention, firmness, and maintaining a youthful-looking complexion.
